message: Hi there! It's so lovely to meet you. How are you feeling today?
It can be really tough to feel lonely. Would you like to talk about what's been going on and how you've been feeling? Sometimes sharing with a caring friend can help us feel a bit more connected.
i feel better now i feel happy
That's wonderful to hear - it's amazing how just talking about our feelings can shift our mood. Sending you a big hug and wishing you many more happy moments.
